Implementation Plan

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends _mt_final_ci_merge_resume
Scope-mode justification: The issue spells out both parts, and this plan implements exactly those two parts. Part 1 changes the existing final-CI resume loop in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` in two places: one condition and the merge flag. Part 2 adds one best-effort hook to the existing `skip_cycle` path in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` and sends its alert through the existing `promote_cycle_hold_alert` helper. Two small additions keep this complete (Boil the Lake; §6 Core Priorities: Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed). Each is under 30 lines and adds no dependency or interface. First, `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` is passed to both release steps that run the resume tick. Otherwise an operator's kill switch would be skipped on the `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` path. Second, the alert keeps only PRs whose head is in this repository, so a fork cannot get named in an alert that tells operators to merge it. Nothing else changes: the other sweeps, the forward-merge workflow, the ruleset and the promote guards stay as they are.

## Planning ref
- HEAD `d0fb74c85b9e466001436285e5a3e1a63c326c69`, branch `main`. The integration branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so planning continues.

## §20.E Automation
- **New scripts:** none. This extends `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` (`_mt_final_ci_merge_resume`) and `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` (`skip_cycle`).
- **Entry points (unchanged):**
  - `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` runs from `review_merge_train.sh release` (line ~1958). That runs in the step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)" of `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` on every cron tick. It also runs in the step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train)" of `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`, on PR close and on its schedule.
  - The promote alert runs in the `cycle` job of `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` (00:00 UTC schedule).
- **New jobs:** none (§26/§33). Only one env line is added to each of two existing steps.
- **Long-running supervisor:** none.
- **DB work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, because no script is added.

## Conflicts between the issue and the codebase
- **Test file.** The issue puts the Part 1 tests in `tests/test_review_merge_train.py`. On this ref, the `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` tests are in `tests/test_merge_lease.py`: the `ReleaseTick._resume` harness, the `MARK` and `GATE` fixtures, and the fake gh `tests/merge_lease_fake_gh.py`, which records `gh pr merge` argv under `state["merged"]`. The `Wiring` env-switch test is in the same file. Part 1 tests go there; `tests/test_review_merge_train.py` is not changed.
- **Env plumbing in a second workflow.** The issue mentions only `orchestrate_poll.yml`, but `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` also runs `review_merge_train.sh release`, which calls the resume. The existing test `Wiring.test_release_steps_get_the_review_paths_switches` already requires both release steps to receive the review path's switches. Without this line, `vars.FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE=false` would not be honoured on the close path.
- **Pinned-candidate skip at ~1667.** The `base_not_ancestor` skip at ~1667 is the failed-cycle-head compare. Its detail has no `ref=heads/`, and it is not about the stable branch, so it gets no alert. The pinned-candidate check against heads/stable already goes through `require_stable_branch_ancestor` (~597), which does put `ref=heads/${PROMOTE_CYCLE_STABLE_BRANCH}` in the detail. One hook covers both the unpinned and the pinned case.

## Functions or modules to implement

**Part 1: `scripts/review_merge_train.sh`, `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` (~1675–1806)**
1. Remove `|| [[ "${resume_head_ref}" =~ ^auto/forward-merge-stable- ]]` from the `not_eligible` condition (~1729). Forks, drafts, invalid SHAs and integration heads stay `not_eligible`, with no change to their token.
2. Add a new local, `resume_merge_method`, after checking that the name is not used elsewhere in the function or file. Set it for each PR right after the eligibility check:
   - `merge` when the head ref matches `^auto/forward-merge-stable-` (the same hard-coded prefix as `review_enable_auto_merge.sh:400`);
   - `squash` for every other head.
3. Extend the existing auto-merge / hold-label drop block (~1745). Keep its current order: `auto_merge_disabled` first, then `blocked_by_<label>`. Then, when `resume_merge_method=merge` and `[ "${FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE:-true}" != "true" ]` (the same exact `true` comparison as `review_autofix.yml:1496`), call `_mt_final_ci_pending_unlabel` and log `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME pr=<n> head=<sha> outcome=dropped reason=forward_merge_auto_merge_disabled`, then `continue`. This happens before the statuses read, so the drop costs no API call.
4. Forward-merge heads then pass through every existing gate unchanged:
   - marker on head created by the automation login;
   - head-gate success from that login;
   - `_pr_wait_for_required_checks ... 0`;
   - named CI `success`;
   - `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`.
5. In the merge call, replace the hard-coded `--squash` with `"--${resume_merge_method}"`. Keep `--auto --match-head-commit "${resume_sha}"`. This changes no API call count, only the flag.
6. Add ` method=${resume_merge_method}` to the end of the success log line: `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME pr= head= outcome=auto_merge_enabled reason=final_ci_green method=squash|merge`. The `auto_merge_refused` failure warning also gets ` method=` at the end, so a refusal of a merge commit can be diagnosed (for example, "Allow merge commits" turned off).
7. Rewrite the header comment (~1675–1694) so that it:
   - drops "or forward-merge head" from the not-eligible list;
   - says forward-merge fallback heads get `--merge`, because a squash strips stable's ancestry and `promote-main-to-stable.yml`'s pre-flight would then refuse;
   - says they are gated by `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` (default `true`, otherwise `reason=forward_merge_auto_merge_disabled`);
   - says the review path does NOT own them after its checks wait timed out (incident: #9891);
   - updates the `Log:` line with `method=`.
8. Add `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` (default `true`) to the script's top-of-file env documentation block, if it has one.

**Env plumbing**
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)": add `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE: ${{ vars.FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE || 'true' }}` next to `ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE` (2-space YAML indentation).
- `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`, step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train)": add the same line.
- The helper defaults to `true` on its own (§8), so a run staged from an older workflow still works.

**Part 2: `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`**
1. Add a new function, `promote_cycle_forward_merge_pending <skip_reason> <skip_detail>`, placed next to `promote_cycle_hold_alert` (~861). Grep first to confirm the name is unique. It is always called as `|| true`, so errexit is off inside it: check every step explicitly, as the release-blocker functions do (comment ~1084). It does this:
   - Return 0 unless the reason is `base_not_ancestor` and the detail contains ` ref=heads/`.
   - Use a once-per-tick guard variable (`promote_cycle_forward_merge_pending_done`, with the same idempotency shape as `release_blocker_on_skip_done`).
   - Take `base=` (the stable branch SHA) and `head=` (the main tip or pinned candidate) from the detail with a bash regex. Keep each only if it matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`; otherwise use `unknown`.
   - Make one REST read, with a §14 audit comment above it: `gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&base=${PROMOTE_CYCLE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}&per_page=100"`. The audit comment says that nothing else in this script lists PRs, that the `/issues?` listing in guard 2 is label-filtered tracking issues, and that the read runs only on this skip path.
   - Filter with jq: `.head.ref | startswith("auto/forward-merge-stable-")` AND `.head.repo.full_name == env repo`. Keep `.number` values that match `^[1-9][0-9]*$`. Build each URL as `https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pull/<n>`; never echo the API's `html_url` or title.
   - When the read or the jq parse fails, set `prs=lookup_failed`. When it succeeds with no match, set `prs=none`. Otherwise use a comma-separated list of numbers.
   - Print `PROMOTE_CYCLE_FORWARD_MERGE_PENDING prs=<n,...|none|lookup_failed> base=<sha> head=<sha> ref=heads/<stable>` to stdout.
   - Call `promote_cycle_hold_alert "<text>"` once. It is best-effort and timed out after 30 s, and it does nothing without tg_
